title.en: BRUNEI NATIONAL ENERGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE ORDER 2011

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-79-2011-BRUNEI-NATIONAL-ENERGY-RESEARCH-INSTITUTE-ORDER-2011.pdf》（16 页），本次切分 22 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en:
(1) This Order may be cited as the Brunei National Energy Research Order, 2011 and shall commence on a date to be appointed by the with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, by notification in the Gazette.

(2) The long title of this Order is "An Order to provide for the of the Brunei National Energy Research Institute and for matters connected therewith".

In this Order, unless the context otherwise requires - means the Board established by section 5; "chief executive officer" means the chief executive officer of the Institute under section 10; means oil, gas, renewable energy, electricity and includes energy and conservation; means the Brunei National Energy Research Institute established by section 3; means member of the Board appointed under section 5 and the chairman; means the Minister of Energy at the Office of the Prime Minister; Secretary" means the Permanent Secretary at the Office of the

OF INSTITUTE of Institute.

(1) The Institute shall have a common seal and the seal may, from time to time, be broken, altered or made anew as the Institute thinks fit.

(2) All courts, judges and persons acting judicially shall take judicial notice of the common seal of the Institute affixed to any document and shall presume that it was duly affixed.

OF BOARD of Board.

(1) There shall be a Board which shall consist of {aj a chairman; fbf a deputy chairman; and {c} not more than 15 other members, all of whom shall be appointed by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan.

(2) The Board shall be the executive body of the Institute, which may exercise all the powers conferred on the Institute under this Order.

(3) The First Schedule shall have effect with respect to the Board, its and proceedings. of committees and delegation of powers.

(1) The Board may appoint from among its own members or other persons who are not members such number of committees as it thinks fit consisting of or other persons or members and other persons for purposes which, in the opinion of the Board, would be better regulated and managed by means of such committees.

(2) The Board may, subject to such conditions or restrictions as it thinks fit, to any such committee or to any member, officer or employee of the any of the functions or powers of the Board under this Order or any other law, except the power of delegation conferred by this section.

(3) No delegation under this section shall prevent the performance or any function or power by the Board. of Board.

The chief executive officer shall be the secretary to the Board.

DUTIES AND POWERS OF INSTITUTE of Institute.

(1) Subject to this Order, the Institute may carry on such activities as to the Institute to be advantageous, necessary or convenient for it to carry on for or in connection with the discharge of its functions and duties under this or any other written law, and in particular, the Institute may exercise any of the powers specified in the Second Schedule. j2) This section shall not be construed as limiting any power of the Institute by or under any other written law.

RELATING TO STAFF of chief executive officer and other employees etc.

(1) The Board shall, with the approval of the Minister, appoint a chief executive officer on such terms and conditions as the Board may determine. {2) The chief executive officer shall be the chief administrative and officer of the Institute and shall be responsible for - {a} the proper administration and management of the Institute in with the policy of the Institute; {b) the collaboration, communication and liaison with the Government and other industry sectors;

(c) the academic and research management of the Institute in with the policy of the Institute; and

(d) the overall discipline of the fellows, officers and employees of the and for those purposes the chief executive officer shall, subject to this Order, have all such powers as are necessary or advantageous and proper.

(3) If the chief executive officer is temporarily absent from Brunei or is temporarily unable to perform his duties, by reason of illness or another person may be appointed by the Minister to act in place of the executive officer during any such period of absence from duty. {4) The Minister may, from time to time, appoint and employ on such terms and conditions as he may determine such other employees, consultants and agents as may be necessary for the effective performance of its functions. from personal liability.

No suit or other legal proceedings shall lie personally against any member, or employee of the Institute or other person acting under the direction of the Institute for anything which is done in good faith or intended to be done in execution or purported execution of this Order. servants.

All members, officers and employees of the Institute shall be deemed to be public servants for the purposes of the Penal Code (Chapter 22).

PROVISIONS Bank accounts.

The Institute shall open and maintain an account or accounts with such bank or banks as the Institute thinks fit; and every such account shall be operated upon as far as practicable by cheque signed by such person or persons as may from time to time be authorised in that behalf by the Institute. of funds.

The funds of the Institute shall be applied only in payment or discharge of the expenses, obligations and liabilities of the Institute and in making any payments that the Institute is authorised or required to make. to borrow.
The Institute may invest any of its funds available for investment in such shares, funds, securities or investments as may be authorised by the Minister.

(1) The Minister of Finance shall cause to be paid to the Institute such as may be approved by the Government from time to time as grants-in· the Institute.

(2) All money provided for under subsection (1) may be applied or expended by the Institute for all or any of the purposes of the Institute. financial provisions.
The financial provisions set out in the Third Schedule shall have effect with respect to the Institute. of secrecy.

(1) Except for the purpose of the performance of his duties or the exercise or when lawfully required to do so by any court or under the any written law, no person who is or has been a member, an officer, an employee or an agent of the Institute or a member of a committee of the Institute shall disclose any information relating to the affairs of the Institute or of any other person which has been obtained by him in the performance of his or the exercise of his functions.

(2) who contravenes subsection (1) is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $2,000, imprisonment for a term not 12 months or both. report.

The Institute shall, as soon as practicable after the end of each financial year, the Minister an annual report on the activities of the Institute during year and the Minister shall cause a copy of every such report to be to His Majesty the Sultan in CounciL by Minister.
The Minister may give to the Board such directions, not inconsistent with the provision of this Order, as he thinks fit as to the performance of its functions and exercise of its powers.
